pythonFunction.name: register_restoration_sms
pythonFunction.description:
Signs the customer up for a text message when service is restored. Needs an identified caller
with a mobile number on file. Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing
phrase while it runs.

Args:
    account_id: Leave empty: the identified account is used automatically (any other id is refused).
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok and sent_to_last4.
